left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adults over 50 years old  [AND] with degenerative scoliosis  [AND] (n=20) with pain (>2/10)

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Curves over 50° are surgical candidates, and will be excluded

right.raw_text: Patients who have had cortisone  [OR] or anesthetic injections within the last 3 months, surgery  [OR] or presenting contra-indications to exercises (fractures, [OR]  cancer, severe cardio-vascular co-morbidities, [OR]  or osteopenia) will be excluded
